name: Rafael Nadal
rankNote: retired legend; on the roster as Ryan's pick (Nov 9 2026), not in the live top 20
era: early 'pirate' era, 2005–2008: long hair, bandana, sleeveless shirt and three-quarter 'pirate' (capri) pants. Later look (about 2009 on): shorter hair, headband, sleeved shirts and shorts
signature: left-hander with long hair under a bandana, a sleeveless shirt showing big arms, and knee-length 'pirate' pants; the whipping lasso forehand
exaggerate: bandana with long hair sticking out the back
sleeveless shirt and big, muscular arms (left arm swings the racket)
pirate pants ending just below the knee
lasso-style forehand finish over the head
source: looks, rituals and celebrations: public media, one link per claim in `sources` (Nov 9 2026); height (about 1.85 m) is general knowledge and still needs to be checked; hex colours wait on stills (#18) Body numbers added Nov 11 2026 from the 2026 ATP media guide where the player is listed, otherwise the source named in body.

grass.notes: All-white dress code, including the bandana. Pirate-length pants at Wimbledon are the chosen era and remain to confirm.

hard.notes: Pirate-era silhouette (sleeveless, capri, bandana) is sourced. The 2005–08 US Open colours were not read from a still. Navy shirt is the neutral default. Bandana red is not a sourced hex.

clay.notes: 2005 clay: yellow shirt and white pirate trousers (sources already in this file). Bandana red is not in that report.

personality.temperament: fierce, intense competitor, all-out effort on every ball; humble and polite off court
mannerisms: pre-serve routine: tugs his shorts, tucks his hair behind the left ear then the right, wipes his face, bounces the ball, then serves
lines up two water bottles in front of his chair, labels facing the court
keeps a towel at both corners of the court since the serve clock
personality.notes: he says the rituals are not superstition but a way to order his surroundings; public media for rituals, bottles and trophy bite
toConfirm: big uppercut fist pump with a 'Vamos' roar

sources.claim: short tugs, hair tucks and water bottles: his rituals
two bottles at his feet aimed at the court; 'not superstition' (his own words)
towel at both corners of the court since the serve clock
the trophy bite began at Monte Carlo 2005
sleeveless shirt and pirate shorts era, 2005–2008
Nadal on his early look: long hair, bandana, 'horrible' but part of his identity
'there are two Rafas': the competitor on court and the calm person off it
Wikipedia infobox: 1.85 m, left-handed, two-handed backhand
ATP overview archived Dec 2018: 185 cm, 85 kg, left-handed, two-handed backhand

body.era: Pirate era, 2005–2008, as already chosen in this file. The 2026 media guide's legends page does not reprint height or weight.

reachM.note: Same formula as bodyStats() in index.html. Not a measured wingspan. datasets/players/<id>/body.json does not exist yet (Body Scout has not run).

letRate.note: Same range already used for Sinner (0.02) and Alcaraz (0.03): lets on roughly 1–3% of pro serves. Not counted from a match log.

skills.scale: 1–20, 10 = neutral, the Skills Coach scale in src/skills/skills.js
skills.note: Not a measured rating. Set from the published style already in this file (serve size, footspeed, touch) so the locker room is not all 10s.

torsoScale.note: look.torso in src/players/roster.js is a pixel width multiplier taken from words already in signature/exaggerate (lanky, broad, slim). It is not a measured shoulder width.

favouriteServes.summary: Heavy topspin lefty serve, kick on the second.
favouriteServes.from: era notes; kick share is not a counted percentage
